question: Choose the antonym of 'inflate":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reduce**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"inflate"** means to fill something with air or gas, causing it to expand or increase in size; metaphorically, it can also mean to increase or magnify something excessively. (फुलाना या बढ़ाना)

 
 
• **Example:** The balloon inflated quickly as air was pumped into it.
 
 
 
• **"Reduce"** refers to the act of making something smaller in size, amount, or degree; it is the opposite of inflate. (कम करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The government decided to reduce taxes to help small businesses.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **"inflate"** is **"reduce."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Reduce**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Increase** (बढ़ाना): To make something larger or greater in size, amount, or degree.

 
 
• **Example:** The company plans to increase its production capacity next year.
 
 
 
• **Expand** (विस्तार करना): To spread out or grow in size, area, or volume.
 
 
• **Example:** The business is looking to expand its operations into new markets.
 
 
 
• **Swell** (सूजना): To grow larger or rounder, often due to pressure or injury.
 
 
• **Example:** His ankle began to swell after the fall.
